# Test subjects

These small subjects exercise public owners independently of the shipped GPT lesson. They are excluded from the package and catalog.

| Subject       | Contracts                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `scene-shell` | Model input/history, layout, measuring grid, plot labels, media clock, camera, widget persistence, arbitrary subject checkpoint and export |
| `arithmetic`  | 2D/3D MathMorph, tensor selection and exact provenance, result delivery, shader reuse and reverse seek                                     |
| `chapters`    | Stage/paper composition, character contact, live drawing, focus and chapter boundaries                                                     |
| `physics`     | 2D/3D body adapters, grabbing, deformation, reset and disposal                                                                             |
| `svg`         | Generated SVG entry, orbit, label layout and overflow disclosure                                                                           |
| `smil`        | Native SVG clock and the shared player                                                                                                     |
| `python-svg`  | Cold Python/uv preparation and pinned standalone CLI builds                                                                                |

Tests of retired lesson-specific models (register, BERT projection, computer internals, fractions, balance, volume) leave with those lessons. Transferable rendering, causality, checkpoint, interaction and release contracts remain in these subjects and owner-level tests. The public GPT lesson has its own mathematical and browser acceptance.
